name: Сир твердий
source: Current Ukrainian retail references for classic hard/semi-hard cheeses
audit_note: Generic-first carbohydrate reference for ordinary hard/semi-hard cheese. Many current classic cheeses declare 0 g carbohydrates/100 g. Exact protein/fat/energy vary by variety, but brand proliferation is not useful for carbohydrate counting; recipe-dependent cheeses with additions remain separate candidates.

name: Моцарела свіжа
source: Current Ukrainian retail references for fresh mozzarella in brine
audit_note: Generic-first fresh mozzarella reference. Current products are low-carbohydrate but label values vary modestly, commonly around 0–2 g/100 g; 1.0 g is retained as a practical generic reference rather than creating brand duplicates.

name: Сир Фета / фета-тип
source: Current Ukrainian retail references for feta/brined feta-type cheese
audit_note: Generic-first reference for feta and closely related brined feta-type cheese. Plain products remain low-carbohydrate; branded variants should only be split when their label shows a materially different recipe/profile.

name: Сир плавлений вершковий
source: Current Ukrainian retail references for plain creamy processed cheese
audit_note: Plain creamy processed cheese is represented generically, but processed-cheese recipes vary more than natural hard cheese. Products with starch, flavours, ham/mushroom additions or materially different carbohydrate labels should be handled as branded recipe-dependent variants rather than forced into this profile.
